key_path: Consumer agent path (fastest): add Claude connector 'Booking.com' (https://demandapi-mcp.booking.com/v1/mcp/8132308) -> search accommodations with NO authentication -> booking completes on booking.com via link.
Developer path: become a Managed Affiliate Partner (apply, sign contract).
Account Manager enables Partner Centre access -> generate Demand API key + X-Affiliate-Id.

Call sandbox https://demandapi-sandbox.booking.com/3.2 (same credentials as prod) or partner MCP https://demandapi-mcp.booking.com/v1/sp/mcp/ with x-booking-affiliate-id + x-booking-authorization headers.

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no - partner MCP uses static affiliate id + API key headers; consumer connector is unauthenticated
agent_native_auth.sandboxes: yes - Demand API sandbox (no separate keys, but requires partner credentials)
agent_native_auth.free_tier: consumer search free; API only via affiliate contract

remote.name: Booking.com connector (consumer)
remote.auth: none for search (per docs); our probe from India got CloudFront 403 - likely client/geo filtered

remote.name: Booking.com partner MCP server
remote.auth: x-booking-affiliate-id + x-booking-authorization (Demand API key, no Bearer)

types: commerce/search MCP (accommodations_search only; order creation not included)
mcp.directories: Claude directory: 'Booking.com' (Claude Web/Desktop/Mobile/Cowork; docs say NOT Claude Code). ChatGPT: Booking.com app (Apps in ChatGPT launch partner, Oct 2025).
agentic_commerce_protocols: none for in-agent booking; redirect to booking.com

docs_for_agents.build_with_ai: yes - MCP server docs (about, implementation guide) + booking-connector docs
docs_for_agents.robots_ai_stance: booking.com robots.txt has no AI-specific user-agent rules

score_justification: Frictionless consumer search connector and agent-ready docs (llms.txt, .md, OpenAPI, MCP guide), but every developer credential requires a managed-affiliate contract and booking cannot be completed in-agent.
best_practice: Same MCP backend serves an auth-free consumer connector and a partner-keyed server; tools/list is declared the source of truth per account.
biggest_gap: Managed Affiliate contract + Account Manager gate; partner terms reportedly restrict AI use without written approval; no order creation tool.
